nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.text: Excuse me, are you alright? You look lost.

nodes.speaker: redHood
nodes.text: Oh! You startled me... I'm fine, just picking flowers for my grandmother.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.text: Your grandmother? Where does she live? I'm heading through the forest and could check on her.

choices.text: Tell me, I'll make sure she's safe.
I just need directions, that's all.

nodes.speaker: redHood
nodes.text: That's kind of you... She lives past the second grove, in the cottage by the old oak tree. But please, the woods are dangerous after dark.

nodes.speaker: redHood
nodes.text: Go through two groves, then look for the old oak tree. Her cottage is right beside it.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.text: I'll keep that in mind. Stay safe out here.

nodes.speaker: redHood
nodes.text: Thank you! I should hurry now, grandmother will be worried. Goodbye!
